## Highlights

coyotenote now comes in two parts: the terminal app you know, and **coyotenote-web**, an experimental browser version. Both are in the same archive and work on the same plain Markdown vaults.

## coyotenote-web (experimental)

Run `coyotenote-web` and open http://127.0.0.1:4280. It serves only your own computer: there is no account, sync or remote access, and all browser assets are built in.

- **Write** in a rich editor, or switch to **Markdown** source, **Preview** or **Split** view.
- `[[Wiki links]]` with suggestions, backlinks and back navigation, and links rewritten when you rename or move a note.
- Search note names and contents, with the matching passage shown.
- All 14 themes, focus mode and a mobile layout.
- Autosave with conflict checks. When another program changed the note, **Compare versions** shows both side by side so you can keep either one.
- Browser drafts survive reloads and server restarts.
- A **Trash** list restores any deleted note.

Its default vault is `~/.local/share/coyotenote-web`, separate from the terminal app's. Only one app at a time can open a vault. See `docs/WEB.md` in the archive.

## Terminal app

The two apps now share one vault implementation, so they read and write notes by the same rules. For the terminal app this means:

- Deleting a note whose name is already in the trash keeps both, saving the new one as "Name 2", instead of refusing. Ctrl+Z restores the right one.
- Folders left empty by a move or delete are removed.
- Notes that haven't changed are not read from disk again.

## Security and requirements

- Dependencies with known vulnerabilities were updated: `golang.org/x/net`, `golang.org/x/text` and `goldmark`. `govulncheck` reports no findings.
- Building from source now needs **Go 1.26** or newer.

## Downloads

One archive for **Linux amd64** holds `coyotenote`, `coyotenote-web`, the README, the license and third-party notices. Check it against `SHA256SUMS`. Windows and arm64 archives are no longer published.

[Full changelog: v0.3.2 → v0.4.0](https://github.com/eg36/Coyotenote/compare/v0.3.2...v0.4.0)
